versions.subject: Update sysmon_always_install_elevated_msi_spawned_cmd_and_powershell_spawned_processes.yml
versions.detection:
parent_image:
    ParentImage|contains: 
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
parent_of_parent_image:
    ParentOfParentImage|contains|all: 
        - '\Windows\Installer\'
        - 'msi'
    ParentOfParentImage|endswith: 
        - 'tmp'
condition: parent_image and parent_of_parent_image
